;; Multi-variable wide rule (D19/D23): one two-row rule copies six cells at
;; once -- the shape of the tetris line-clear rewrite.  `poke` exercises the
;; D23 corner: the ZIP value substitutes a literal `1` into an unmasked
;; position inside a block whose masks are already fixed, so that cell is an
;; ordinary literal while the masked `9` stays a variable.

CLASS cell ABC

GOAL
Z

#ABCACB#
#------#
#1A#####

BIND c copy_row "copy row" l poke "poke"

CMD copy_row
 ATOMIC 1 cell 2 cell 3 cell 4 cell 5 cell 6 cell
  #123456# #123456#
  #??????# #123456#

CMD poke
 ATOMIC 9 cell
  ZIP z 1
   z9 zE
